title: Rotated-key answer is in: what should we tell Stuart on KS-843?
bluf: Seat S 122nd read the code at develop 9c1ecde5abd6 (45 file:line cites, checked by program; live keys and hosts NOT read). A rotate copies nothing from the old key: the new key gets a fixed nine-scope set incl. subjects:erase at 3,000 an hour (unless the request names its own scopes or the host overrides the limit). A key minted before KS-869 (6 Sep) has no connector id, so the rotate does not switch it off; it stays live until revoked by its id, and the reply says 'rotated: false' with a warning only when NONE of the connector's keys carry an id. Also: the erase route does not enforce subjects:erase yet (switch unset), so S's old key can still erase today. Stuart asked you directly (item 6 on KS-772) and waits on it. Findings: fleet/briefs_staged/2026-11-25_S122_findings.txt. Link: https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-843 (Override of the prior-ruling gate: secuura-rotated-key-erase-scope-1125 = a ruled the code READ and said 'nothing is posted to Stuart until you rule again': this card is that second ruling. The other matches share only 'reply' or 'stuart' and rule other subjects.)

options.label: Post the code facts to Stuart on KS-843
options.detail: a seat posts a short facts-only comment: what a rotated key carries, that pre-6-Sep keys stay live until revoked by id, and that the rotate reply echoes the request (read stored scopes back through validate); no promise, no live-data claim; you see the draft's text on the panel before it posts

options.label: Read dev-ps's real keys first, then post
options.detail: a seat reads dev-ps's key rows read-only (scopes, limit, connector id, active, created) on the stack S uses, so the reply says which case applies; then the same facts-only post

default_action: If you don't answer: nothing is posted; Stuart's re-key stays waiting, and the 48-hour reminder re-raises it.
_override_prior: secuura-rotated-key-erase-scope-1125 = a explicitly reserved the Stuart post for a second ruling; the other three matches share a word only (KS-2103 reply shape, a 11-15 WhatsApp, the 11-23 meeting list).
